Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Test Engine module with BCODE interpreter and TestRunner

Implement complete test execution engine for Supabase firmware rewrite:

- BCODEInterpreter: Parses and executes BCODE test instructions
  - All 12 legacy opcodes supported \(0,1,2,3,10,11,14,15,16,20,21,99\)
  - Nested repeat blocks \(up to 4 levels\)
  - Callback-based hardware integration
  - Delay loop with heater control integration

- TestRunner: Orchestrates test lifecycle
  - Test initialization and finalization
  - Spectrophotometer data collection \(300 readings max\)
  - Cartridge removal detection and graceful cancellation
  - Stress test mode with LED power variation
  - Test record generation with CRC32 checksum

- BCODE_SPECIFICATION.md: Complete documentation of instruction set

- Unit tests: 18 tests covering parsing, execution, and edge cases

Implements PRD user stories: TEST-001 through TEST-008

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix Supabase firmware API compatibility and compile errors

Refactored firmware to resolve numerous API mismatches between main.ino
and the actual class/namespace implementations:

- SupabaseClient.cpp: Added POSIX headers, fixed BrevitestTestRecord
  field access \(cartridge_id, assay_id instead of header.xxx\)
- SerialCommands: Renamed CommandCategory enum values with CAT_ prefix
  to avoid BLE macro collision, fixed Spectrophotometer method calls
- HardwareConfig.h: Added #ifndef guards for version macros, removed
  duplicate SPECTRO_* constexpr that conflicted with DataTypes.h macros
- TestRunner: Renamed StateChangeCallback to TestStateChangeCallback,
  removed invalid BuzzerController forward declaration \(it''s a namespace\)
- main.ino: Updated all API calls to use correct methods \(getCurrentMode,
  isReady, getCurrentPosition, enableLaser/disableLaser, etc.\) and
  namespace syntax for BuzzerController:: and LEDController::

Compiled binary included: brevitest-supabase-v100.bin \(57KB\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
